archive/metadata#

What an archive records about a member besides its bytes: permissions, the time it was changed, its owner and a comment.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let metadata = ArchiveMetadata(
    mode: PermissionMode(420),
    modified: ArchiveModificationFromEpoch(1762000000).local_date_time(),
    comment: "",
);

Description#

What an archive records about a member besides its bytes: permissions, the time it was changed, its owner and a comment.

A member may lack a mode or an owner: reading one then throws MissingArchiveMode or MissingArchiveOwnership.

object ArchiveMetadata#

object ArchiveMetadata

Immutable archive metadata snapshot. The supplied calendar, comment, mode and ownership are retained, not inferred from the host. Constructor overloads bind calendar/comment alone, with mode, or with mode and ownership; absent observations throw MissingArchiveMode/MissingArchiveOwnership. Private zero-or-one arrays represent presence without fake values, null or magic numeric identities. No mutation, account lookup, permission application or owned resources.

let time = ArchiveModificationFromEpoch(0.rat()).value();
let info = ArchiveMetadata(time, "member comment");
info.modification(); // unchanged UTC epoch calendar
info.mode();         // throws MissingArchiveMode

ZIP local calendar fields bind directly: no implicit offset, process zone or daylight-saving resolution. TAR epoch seconds are explicitly converted with ArchiveModificationFromEpoch. Comment Unicode and nanoseconds remain exact; format adapters enforce their own field ranges and encoding restrictions.

object ArchiveModificationFromEpoch#

object ArchiveModificationFromEpoch

Exact epoch seconds represented as UTC calendar fields for archive metadata. Constructor binds a Duration: nonintegral nanoseconds throw InvalidDuration. value() performs pure calendar arithmetic; outside 1..9999 throws InvalidDate. Negative/fractional seconds are supported, with no clock or timezone lookup.
